*Community Corrections Agency Selects SuperCom's GPS, RF, & Domestic Violence Monitoring Technology*


*Second Direct Contract in Indiana Follows SuperCom's Entry Into the State Earlier This Year*


NEW YORK


, Nov. 17, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- SuperCom (NASDAQ:SPCB ), a global provider of secure solutions for the e-Government, IoT, and Cybersecurity sectors, today announced that it has secured a direct county-level electronic monitoring contract with a community corrections agency in Indiana. The award is SuperCom's second contract in the state, following its entry into Indiana earlier this year, and represents a full displacement of the agency's incumbent electronic monitoring provider.


Under the agreement, SuperCom will deploy its PureSecurity suite, including the PureOne product, to provide the agency with continuous monitoring capabilities. Rollout is scheduled to begin in December 2026. The contract will follow a recurring revenue model based on daily active units.


"We are pleased to secure our second county contract in Indiana, reflecting the growing reputation and trust we are establishing among U.S. correctional agencies," commented Ordan Trabelsi, President and CEO of SuperCom. "Agencies are choosing SuperCom because of the performance of our technology, the quality of our service and the value we provide. Each successful deployment further strengthens our reputation, deepens our market presence and positions us to pursue additional opportunities across the country."


"With more than 50 new electronic monitoring contracts secured across the U.S. since mid-2024 and over 20 national project wins in Europe, our continued expansion across both markets reflects the strength of our technology and execution capabilities," Trabelsi continued. "This momentum is also reflected in our financial performance, with trailing twelve-month EBITDA¹ reaching approximately $12.1 million through the third quarter of 2026. Our continued success in securing new contracts across a broad range of programs and jurisdictions is strengthening our market presence, reinforcing our competitive position and increasingly positioning us to win larger and more meaningful opportunities. Our mission remains to revolutionize public safety through innovative electronic monitoring technology and complementary services."


SuperCom's PureOne is an all-in-one GPS tracking bracelet designed for continuous indoor and outdoor location monitoring. Using advanced location and communication technologies, PureOne delivers accurate positioning together with tamper detection and dynamic geo-fence alerts, and is compatible with other devices in SuperCom's PureSecurity Suite.


**About SuperCom**


Founded in 1988, SuperCom (NASDAQ:[SPCB](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/supercom-to-report-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-on-november-12th-2026-302932100.html?tc=eml_cleartime#financial-modal) ) is a global provider of IoT, cybersecurity, and digital identity solutions for governments and enterprises worldwide.


SuperCom's IoT solutions combine proprietary wearable devices, communications technology, and monitoring software to deliver real-time electronic monitoring for public safety. Its PureSecurity suite, including the PureOne GPS monitoring solution and the PureProtect domestic violence monitoring solution, is deployed in government programs across Europe and North America.


Through its wholly owned cybersecurity subsidiary Safend, SuperCom provides endpoint data protection, data loss prevention, encryption, and device and port control solutions, helping organizations protect sensitive information and prevent unauthorized data access and transfer. SuperCom has also introduced SafeGenie, a suite for the real-time monitoring and control of AI agents.


SuperCom also delivers e-Government solutions for secure identification, biometric enrollment, document issuance, and border control.
